name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
benefit: ₹6,000 per year in three instalments of ₹2,000 paid directly to the bank account

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
benefit: Assured pension of ₹3,000 per month from age 60. The farmer pays ₹55 to ₹200 per month and the government pays an equal amount

name: Rythu Bharosa
benefit: ₹12,000 per acre per year (₹6,000 per crop season for kharif and rabi) as crop investment support for cultivable land, paid by direct bank transfer

name: Rythu Bima
benefit: ₹5 lakh life insurance paid to the nominee if the farmer dies; the government pays the premium

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
benefit: ₹200 per month (age 60–79) or ₹500 per month (age 80+) from the Centre; states add a top-up

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
benefit: Deposit-free LPG connection with first refill and stove free, plus ₹1,600 connection assistance (₹1,150 for a 5 kg cylinder)

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
benefit: ₹300 per month from the Centre for widows aged 40–79; states add a top-up

name: Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam
benefit: One-time ₹1,00,116 marriage assistance paid to the bride's bank account (₹1,25,145 for brides with disabilities)

name: Shaadi Mubarak
benefit: One-time ₹1,00,116 marriage assistance for brides from minority communities (₹1,25,145 for brides with disabilities)

name: Mahalakshmi (free bus travel)
benefit: Free travel for women in TGSRTC buses within Telangana (zero-fare ticket)
